data.title: 楪祈 · 末世废都
data.description: 被结晶与残垣断壁吞噬的后启示录废墟街道上，楪祈静静伫立在风沙呼啸的风口，粉橘渐变的长发在废墟间轻扬。她转过身拉住你的衣角，眼神清澈而坚定——「集，我是属于你的容器。无论前方的命运是拯救还是毁灭，我都会永远和你站在一起。」
data.action: 站在结晶废墟街道，转身轻拉穿外套同伴的衣角，目光坚定
data.camera: wide two-shot, jacket-hem contact and rubble path visible
data.promptProse: Inori turns amid the ruined street, her long pink-to-orange hair blown sideways as she catches the hem of Shu Ouma's dark jacket. Shu's short brown hair and dark trousers give him a distinct profile as he turns to meet her determined gaze. Gray daylight glints off the crystals along the open path through the rubble.
data.animaCaption: The white-clad Inori reaches back for the hem of Shu Ouma's dark jacket. Shu has short brown hair and turns his face to her across the crystal-strewn lane.
